lines.zh: 我踩着浪底的沉船木板往前走。
lines.en: I walk along planks salvaged from a sunken hull.

lines.zh: 金剑拖在沙上，划出一道亮痕。
lines.en: My golden blade drags through sand, leaving a bright line.

lines.zh: 靴子里灌满了海水，我不在乎。
lines.en: Seawater fills my boots, and I do not care.

lines.zh: 这双腿走过甲板，现在走海底。
lines.en: These legs once walked a deck; now they walk the seabed.

lines.zh: 我数着步子，像在数没捞上来的金子。
lines.en: I count steps like coins I never hauled up.

lines.zh: 海草缠住脚踝，我用剑柄挑开。
lines.en: Kelp wraps my ankle; I flick it off with my hilt.

lines.zh: 船没了，可我还按着航线走。
lines.en: The ship is gone, yet I still keep to the course.

lines.zh: 每走一步，身上的盐就掉一层。
lines.en: Every step sheds another crust of salt from my coat.

lines.zh: 我朝有灯光的地方走，不为求救。
lines.en: I walk toward the lights, and not to be rescued.

lines.zh: 甲板在头顶，我在它下面巡逻。
lines.en: The deck lies overhead; I patrol beneath it.

lines.zh: 锚链响一声，我就换个方向。
lines.en: When the anchor chain rings, I change direction.

lines.zh: 湿透的木头在我脚下吱吱叫。
lines.en: Sodden wood creaks beneath my boots.

lines.zh: 涨潮时我走得更快，水推着我。
lines.en: At high tide the water pushes me, and I walk faster.

lines.zh: 我不记得港口，只记得往哪走。
lines.en: I forget the harbor, but I remember which way to go.

lines.zh: 我踩过一只海星，它碎了。
lines.en: I step on a starfish and it crumbles.

lines.zh: 我朝着沉船的裂口走。
lines.en: I walk toward the breach in the wreck.

lines.zh: 金剑插在沙里，我扶着它站岗。
lines.en: My golden sword stands in the sand; I lean on it.

lines.zh: 没有船长的哨声，我不知该歇多久。
lines.en: Without the captain's whistle, I do not know how long to rest.

lines.zh: 海流把我的衣袖吹得鼓起来。
lines.en: The current billows my ragged sleeve like a sail.

lines.zh: 我在等一个不会来的水手。
lines.en: I wait for a sailor who will never come.

lines.zh: 牙齿咬得发酸，可我没有东西可嚼。
lines.en: My teeth ache from clenching; I have nothing to chew.

lines.zh: 贝壳在我脚边开合，像在打拍子。
lines.en: Shells open and close beside me, keeping time.

lines.zh: 潮水退下去，露出我埋的东西。
lines.en: The tide pulls back and shows what I buried.

lines.zh: 我摸剑柄上的缺口，那是老账。
lines.en: I trace the notch in my hilt, an old debt.

lines.zh: 身上的海腥味，连我自己都嫌。
lines.en: Even I dislike the sea rot clinging to my coat.

lines.zh: 泡在水里这么久，我还是渴。
lines.en: Soaked this long, and still I am thirsty.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃我的靴跟，随它去。
lines.en: Something gnaws my boot heel; let it.

lines.zh: 我把金粒在掌心数了又数。
lines.en: I count my gold nuggets over and over in my palm.

lines.zh: 雾散之前，我哪也不去。
lines.en: I go nowhere until the fog lifts.

lines.zh: 远处有钟声，我只当是海浪。
lines.en: A bell rings far off; I take it for surf.

lines.zh: 活人的眼睛，还带热气。
lines.en: Living eyes, and still carrying warmth.

lines.zh: 你站得离水太近了，水手。
lines.en: You stand too near the water, sailor.

lines.zh: 你身上没有咸味，你不曾出过海。
lines.en: You carry no salt; you have never sailed.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的手，看有没有金子。
lines.en: I watch your hands, looking for gold.

lines.zh: 别把背转向我，规矩我早忘了。
lines.en: Do not turn your back; I forgot that rule long ago.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸太急了，像闻到了岸。
lines.en: Your breath is too quick, like you smell land.

lines.zh: 我在你脸上找一张旧船员名单。
lines.en: I search your face for an old crew roster.

lines.zh: 你走路的姿势，不像踩过甲板。
lines.en: You walk like someone who never crossed a deck.

lines.zh: 看什么看，没见过泡胀的船长？
lines.en: What are you staring at, never seen a bloated captain?

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就请你上船。
lines.en: Come closer and I will invite you aboard.

lines.zh: 砍进骨头了，你听见响了吗？
lines.en: That bit bone; did you hear the sound?

lines.zh: 我早死过一次，这次也一样。
lines.en: I already died once; this will be the same.

lines.zh: 盐水从伤口往外流。
lines.en: Salt water runs out of the wound.

lines.zh: 疼是活人的事，我只觉得湿。
lines.en: Pain belongs to the living; I only feel damp.

lines.zh: 我的剑掉了，帮我捡一下？
lines.en: My sword dropped; would you pick it up?

lines.zh: 你砍得不错，可惜砍错了人。
lines.en: A fine cut, but you struck the wrong man.

lines.zh: 这刀口明天就长回去了。
lines.en: This gash will close again by tomorrow.

lines.zh: 帽子掉了，那是船长帽。
lines.en: My hat fell off; that was a captain's hat.

lines.zh: 再补一刀，别让我半死。
lines.en: Finish it with one more; do not leave me half dead.

lines.zh: 海水会替我记住这一下。
lines.en: The seawater will remember this blow for me.

lines.zh: 金子，给我一块金锭。
lines.en: Gold. Hand me one gold ingot.

lines.zh: 你口袋里有金粒的声音。
lines.en: I hear gold nuggets clinking in your pocket.

lines.zh: 把金子放下，你可以走。
lines.en: Set the gold down, and you may walk away.

lines.zh: 我不是贪，我只是记得它值多少。
lines.en: I am not greedy; I just remember what it buys.

lines.zh: 金剑在响，它闻到同类的味道。
lines.en: My golden blade hums; it smells its own kind.

lines.zh: 一枚就够，我从不讲价。
lines.en: One coin is enough; I never haggle.

lines.zh: 你把金子举高一点，我够不着。
lines.en: Hold the gold higher; I cannot quite reach.

lines.zh: 沉船里全是空箱，我受够了。
lines.en: The wreck was all empty chests; I have had enough.

lines.zh: 换，用我的命换你的金子。
lines.en: A trade: my life for your gold.

lines.zh: 别收回去，我还没看够。
lines.en: Do not put it away; I am not done looking.

lines.zh: 让开，我的靴子不认路。
lines.en: Move aside; my boots do not know the way.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是海水泡过的骨头。
lines.en: You bumped into bone that soaked in brine.

lines.zh: 我的剑比你反应快半拍。
lines.en: My blade is half a beat faster than you.

lines.zh: 甲板上撞人是要罚的，老规矩。
lines.en: Bumping a man on deck used to cost a fine.

lines.zh: 站稳了，我身上全是滑的。
lines.en: Steady yourself; everything on me is slick.

lines.zh: 别踩我的剑，那是我的工钱。
lines.en: Do not step on my blade; that is my wage.

lines.zh: 这肩膀扛过箱子和尸体。
lines.en: These shoulders have carried crates and corpses.

lines.zh: 再挤过来，我就拔剑了。
lines.en: Push in again and the sword comes out.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着两百年的海水。
lines.en: Two hundred years of seawater stand between us.

lines.zh: 撞得不疼，我早就没知觉了。
lines.en: It does not hurt; I lost feeling long ago.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是三年前沉下去的那条船。
lines.en: My mate is the ship that went down three years ago.

lines.zh: 海底没有婚礼，只有压舱石。
lines.en: There are no weddings undersea, only ballast stones.

lines.zh: 她替我看罗盘，我替她掌舵。
lines.en: She reads the compass; I hold the wheel.

lines.zh: 两个人的骨头，比一副更沉。
lines.en: Two skeletons sink heavier than one.

lines.zh: 我留着半块金锭，等人来分。
lines.en: I keep half a gold ingot for someone to share.

lines.zh: 海水凉，靠在一起会暖些吗？
lines.en: The water is cold; would leaning together warm us?

lines.zh: 她笑起来，气泡比话多。
lines.en: When she laughs, more bubbles than words come out.

lines.zh: 我们一起数沉船的桅杆。
lines.en: Together we count the masts of sunken ships.

lines.zh: 没有心跳，也就没有誓言。
lines.en: With no heartbeat, there are no vows to keep.

lines.zh: 两个人守一艘船，够了。
lines.en: Two of us guarding one ship is enough.

lines.zh: 金子归我，规矩归海。
lines.en: The gold is mine; the rules belong to the sea.

lines.zh: 我捡起金粒，像捡回一颗牙。
lines.en: I pick up a nugget like a recovered tooth.

lines.zh: 这枚金锭有别人的牙印。
lines.en: This ingot carries someone else's tooth marks.

lines.zh: 弯下腰时，我的剑先着地。
lines.en: When I bend, my sword touches down first.

lines.zh: 捡东西要快，海鸥比人贪。
lines.en: Pick it up fast; gulls are greedier than men.

lines.zh: 闪闪的，沉船里从来不缺。
lines.en: Shiny things; the wreck was never short of them.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进湿透的口袋。
lines.en: I stuff it into a soaked coat pocket.

lines.zh: 这不算偷，海底没人认领。
lines.en: It is not theft; no one claims things on the seabed.

lines.zh: 金子有重量，这点我信。
lines.en: Gold has weight; that much I still believe.

lines.zh: 别抢，我咬人比剑准。
lines.en: Do not grab it; my teeth aim better than my sword.

lines.zh: 活物，热的，就在前面。
lines.en: Something living, something warm, just ahead.

lines.zh: 那份热气归我了。
lines.en: That warmth is mine now.

lines.zh: 我闻到没有盐的血。
lines.en: I smell blood that has no salt in it.

lines.zh: 罗盘指向你，我就跟。
lines.en: The compass points at you; I follow.

lines.zh: 船长的命令是，登船。
lines.en: The captain's order was to board.

lines.zh: 你跑吧，海水会等你。
lines.en: Run if you like; the seawater will wait.

lines.zh: 两百年来第一个能追的。
lines.en: The first thing worth chasing in two hundred years.

lines.zh: 金剑出鞘，声音很轻。
lines.en: The golden sword leaves its sheath almost silently.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，你是货。
lines.en: I have placed you: you are cargo.

lines.zh: 别往岸上跑，岸上没人。
lines.en: Do not run for shore; nobody is on shore.

lines.zh: 我一步一步贴上去，不急。
lines.en: I close in step by step, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你退我就进，海流教我这样。
lines.en: You retreat, I advance; the current taught me that.

lines.zh: 我的剑尖一直对着你的喉咙。
lines.en: My sword tip never leaves your throat.

lines.zh: 你数过自己还有几步吗？
lines.en: Have you counted how many steps you have left?

lines.zh: 这具身体慢，但不会停。
lines.en: This body is slow, but it does not stop.

lines.zh: 别回头，我会在你背后。
lines.en: Do not look back; I will be behind you.

lines.zh: 帽子下没有眼睛，只有方向。
lines.en: No eyes under this hat, only direction.

lines.zh: 我把你围在沉船的中心。
lines.en: I have herded you into the middle of the wreck.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声越来越像鼓点。
lines.en: Your footsteps are starting to sound like a drum.

lines.zh: 等潮水涨起来，你就没路了。
lines.en: When the tide rises, you will have no way out.

lines.zh: 金剑不快，但砍得很实。
lines.en: The golden blade is not fast, but it lands true.

lines.zh: 这一剑算船票钱。
lines.en: Consider this swing your fare.

lines.zh: 我打的每一下都是旧账。
lines.en: Every blow I deal settles an old account.

lines.zh: 别用手挡，金子比骨头硬。
lines.en: Do not block with your hands; gold beats bone.

lines.zh: 砍中了，我听见水声。
lines.en: It connected; I hear water in you.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气漏出来了。
lines.en: The warmth is leaking out of you.

lines.zh: 十点伤害，够你记住我。
lines.en: Ten points of damage is enough to remember me by.

lines.zh: 我不追砍逃跑的人，只追到底。
lines.en: I do not chase cowards; I chase quarry to the end.

lines.zh: 剑上的盐蹭进你的伤口。
lines.en: Salt from my blade works into your cut.

lines.zh: 倒下的都成了我的船员。
lines.en: Those who fall become my crew.

lines.zh: 我从沉船的舱底爬了出来。
lines.en: I climb out of the wreck's flooded hold.

lines.zh: 咸水里睁眼，第一口气是苦的。
lines.en: Opening my eyes in brine, the first breath tastes bitter.

lines.zh: 桅杆断了，可我还站得起来。
lines.en: The mast is broken, but I still stand up.

lines.zh: 金剑还挂在腰上，我就还是我。
lines.en: The golden sword still hangs at my hip; I am still me.

lines.zh: 今晚的海面很静，适合上船。
lines.en: The sea is calm tonight, good for boarding.

lines.zh: 有人把我从沙里挖出来了吗？
lines.en: Has someone dug me out of the sand?

lines.zh: 我带着一身海藻回到岸上。
lines.en: I come ashore wearing a coat of seaweed.

lines.zh: 这具尸体又被潮水推回来了。
lines.en: The tide has pushed this corpse back again.

lines.zh: 从今往后，这条路归我收税。
lines.en: From now on, I collect tolls on this road.

lines.zh: 钟没响，我不算真的醒。
lines.en: The bell did not ring; I am not truly awake.

lines.zh: 火在湿衣服上烧得很慢。
lines.en: Fire burns slowly on soaked cloth.

lines.zh: 我摔在甲板上，骨头散了一地。
lines.en: I hit the deck and my bones scatter.

lines.zh: 我已经在海里泡了两百年。
lines.en: I have soaked in the sea for two hundred years.

lines.zh: 气浪掀掉了我半个肩膀。
lines.en: The blast carries off half my shoulder.

lines.zh: 金剑还握着，箭先不管。
lines.en: My gold sword stays gripped; the arrow can wait.

lines.zh: 法术让我的骨头嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Magic makes my bones hum.

lines.zh: 死人也会饿，这很荒唐。
lines.en: Even the dead get hungry; it is absurd.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的金剑更亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes, and my golden sword shines brighter.

lines.zh: 下面是更黑的水，我往下沉。
lines.en: Below is darker water, and I sink into it.
